turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Sure. After he, she and it, we add -s to the verb. Example: I work. She works.

Try this one:
My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays.

Answer with only the verb.
turns.judgeInput:
KNOWLEDGE STATE (before this tutor turn):
Target form: thirdS. Learner level A2. First language Arabic.
W1 (wrong) strength 1: the verb does not change after he/she/it. Its error: leaves the verb unchanged after he/she/it ("She like tea").
W2 (wrong) strength 2: -s goes on every verb and -es/-ies are not needed. Its error: adds -s wrongly or misspells -es/-ies ("She watchs TV", "I plays").
C1 (correct) strength 1: add -s/-es after he/she/it. Independent correct productions so far: 0.
C2 (correct) strength 0: -es after sh/ch/s/x/o, -ies after consonant + y, no -s after I/you/we/they. Independent correct productions so far: 0.
